Package neqsim.process.engineering.pid

Class PidSafetyFunctionImporter

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.pid.PidSafetyFunctionImporter
public final class PidSafetyFunctionImporter extends Object
Proposes canonical P&ID instruments, voting functions and actual final elements from a configured native SIF.

The native model supplies executable settings; the caller supplies the engineering role and study policy. Existing exact bindings are reused. Unsupported locations or conflicting governed settings fail instead of creating phantom hardware. Rebuild simulation bindings after importing, then validate and test the proposal before retaining results. No hazard analysis, SIL assignment, independence or engineering approval is inferred.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa

      public static PidDesignModel fromNativeFunction(EngineeringProject project, PidDesignModel sourceModel, PidSimulationBindings bindings, ProcessSystem process, ClosedLoopSafetyFunction function, String role)
      Imports a healthy native function into the existing canonical proposal graph.
      Parameters:
      project - governed source project
      sourceModel - canonical graph to extend without mutating the input
      bindings - current bindings before this import
      process - configured isolated copy containing all actual source and target objects
      function - native function whose actual settings are proposed
      role - explicit ESD, HIPPS, MANUAL_ESD, COMPRESSOR_ESD or COMPRESSOR_MANUAL_ESD engineering role
      Returns:
      copied canonical model containing the proposed native function and connections
